title: Binary Trees
definition: A binary tree is a tree structure where each node has at most two children: left and right.
how_it_works: Recursive definition: a binary tree is empty, or has a root node pointing to left/right binary subtrees.
when_to_use: For expressions, search optimization, or hierarchical binary splits.
when_not_to_use: When nodes require more than two branches.
common_mistakes: Treating generic binary trees as BSTs
